evidence_quotes.O: Coming from the film school, I have not seen many digitals that could replace Kodak or Fuji slide film... until now.
evidence_quotes.C: I have tried 4 headsets/headphones with the unit, following syncing directions carefully. I am an advanced tech user, with more than 30 years experience with high tech.
evidence_quotes.E: I have shared a pair with a friend for more than a year and I must say I was amazed the first time I looked through them
evidence_quotes.A: I am very fussy about headsets for my land line phones and find very few acceptable.
evidence_quotes.N: went back to first headphones tried and started again. It connected this time, so now I can listen to my Kindle with this unit.
